packageRules.description: Majors get 30 days and their own PR. A breaking upgrade reviewed on its own, never riding along with patches.
Patches soak for 3 days — enough to clear pnpm 11's 24h minimumReleaseAge gate, which otherwise fails CI on a freshly published package.
Routine dev tooling batches into one PR. Runtime deps stay individual: what ships to users is reviewed one change at a time.

fast-uri's override ceiling is load-bearing. Every parent (ajv, @fastify/ajv-compiler, fast-json-stringify) declares ^3, so 4.x resolves outside all of them; the GHSA patch is in the 3.x line. Renovate proposed raising the bound to <5, which removes the guard and gains nothing. Security alerts still reach us through vulnerabilityAlerts.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
